system.notes: Test cut: exercises the A/B slot write, tryboot and auto-rollback.

notes: Home shows the console's device cards, and tapping one opens that device's own remote rather than whichever activity remote happened to mention it. A device with no saved view gets one from the closest template; a lamp says so instead of pretending. Phones are no longer redirected into the admin console, which had been sending everyone who isn't an administrator to an access-denied page.
